messages.subject: pcountOpen: Hessian not invertible warning but I still get results?
parts:
When I was experimenting with occupancy models, getting non-invertible Hessians was always an error and stopped all calculations. However, now I am using/trying pcountOpen and when "Hessian is not invertible. Try using fewer covariates or providing starting values." shows up, I still get results! This "error" shows up as text in the console, not as a "proper" R warning. Anyone have insights what is going on here? How can I get results if the Hessian is not invertible? I don't get SEs or p-values, but I get coefficients for my covariates and an AIC.

Thanks!
